locale_name.description: Name of this language, written in this language. Used by the language picker in Options. NEVER translate into another language.

appName.description: Extension name. WORKING TITLE - replace once the final name is chosen. NEVER translate: the brand name is identical in every locale.

appShortName.description: Short name used when space is tight (max 12 characters). NEVER translate.

appDesc.message: Capture, annotate and blur screenshots. 100% local: no account, no cloud, no tracking.
appDesc.description: Store description shown in the browser and in the add-on stores. Hard limit of 132 characters - keep translations within it.

mode_area.description: Capture mode button: the user drags a rectangle over the page.

mode_area_desc.message: Drag to capture part of the page
mode_area_desc.description: Secondary line under the Select area button in the popup.

mode_visible.description: Capture mode button: captures exactly what is on screen.

mode_visible_desc.message: Capture what you see right now
mode_visible_desc.description: Secondary line under the Visible part button in the popup.

mode_fullpage.description: Capture mode button: scrolls the page and stitches the whole thing into one image.

mode_fullpage_desc.message: Scroll and stitch the entire page
mode_fullpage_desc.description: Secondary line under the Full page button in the popup.

mode_delay.description: Capture mode button: waits a few seconds before capturing.

mode_delay_desc.message: Wait, then capture the visible part
mode_delay_desc.description: Secondary line under the Delayed capture button in the popup.

popup_settings.description: Popup footer link that opens the Options page.

popup_shortcuts_hint.message: Tip: use keyboard shortcuts for faster captures.
popup_shortcuts_hint.description: Hint shown at the bottom of the popup.

ctx_parent.description: Top-level right-click menu entry. This is the brand name - do NOT translate.

cmd_capture_area.description: Keyboard shortcut description shown in the browser shortcut settings page.

cmd_capture_visible.description: Keyboard shortcut description shown in the browser shortcut settings page.

cmd_capture_fullpage.description: Keyboard shortcut description shown in the browser shortcut settings page.

overlay_hint.description: Instruction shown over the dimmed page before the user starts dragging.

overlay_hint_fullscreen.message: Space to capture the whole screen
overlay_hint_fullscreen.description: Second line of the overlay instruction. Keep short - it sits in a small pill.

overlay_hint_cancel.description: Third line of the overlay instruction. Do NOT translate the key name Esc.

overlay_dimensions.description: Live pixel size readout next to the selection rectangle. Symbols only - do not add words.

overlay_action_capture.description: Button on the small floating toolbar attached to the selection. Keep it to one short word.

overlay_action_copy.description: Floating toolbar button: copy the selection straight to the clipboard. Keep it to one short word.

overlay_action_save.description: Floating toolbar button: save the selection straight to disk. Keep it to one short word.

overlay_action_cancel.description: Floating toolbar button. Keep it to one short word.

delay_countdown.description: Countdown shown before a delayed capture fires.

delay_cancel.description: Button that aborts a delayed capture.

fullpage_preparing.description: Full page progress: hiding fixed elements and scrolling to the top.

fullpage_progress.description: Full page progress counter: screens captured so far out of the total.

fullpage_stitching.description: Full page progress: merging the captured screens into a single image.

fullpage_cancel.description: Button that aborts a full page capture in progress.

editor_title.description: Browser tab title of the editor page.

editor_untitled.description: Fallback name used when the captured page has no title.

tool_move.description: Editor tool: pick an existing shape and drag it.

tool_arrow.description: Editor tool: straight line with an arrowhead.

tool_ellipse.description: Editor tool: circle or oval, used to circle things on the image.

tool_text.description: Editor tool: type a text label onto the image.

tool_highlighter.description: Editor tool: translucent marker, like a highlighter pen on paper.

tool_blur.description: Editor tool: blur or pixelate a region to obscure information.

tool_redact.description: Editor tool: cover a region with a solid opaque block. This is the irreversible, genuinely safe option - the wording should sound definitive, not decorative.

tool_crop.description: Editor tool: trim the image down to a smaller rectangle.

action_save.description: Editor toolbar button: download the image to disk.

action_delete.description: Editor: remove the currently selected shape.

action_clear.description: Editor: remove every shape, keeping the original capture untouched.

action_zoom_reset.description: Editor toolbar button: zoom back to 100 percent.

prop_stroke_width.description: Editor properties panel: line or border thickness in pixels.

prop_fill.description: Editor properties panel: whether the shape is filled or only outlined.

prop_font_size.description: Editor properties panel: text font size.

prop_font_bold.description: Editor properties panel: text style toggle.

prop_font_italic.description: Editor properties panel: text style toggle.

prop_text_outline.description: Editor properties panel: draw a contrasting outline around text so it stays readable on any background.

prop_arrowhead.description: Editor properties panel: which end of the arrow gets the head.

prop_blur_mode.description: Editor properties panel: choose blur or pixelate.

prop_blur_mode_blur.description: Blur mode option: soft gaussian blur.

prop_blur_mode_pixelate.description: Blur mode option: large square blocks, a mosaic effect.

prop_blur_strength.description: Editor properties panel: how strong the blur is, or how large the pixel blocks are.

blur_warning_title.description: Title of the one-time warning shown the first time the blur tool is used.

blur_warning_body.message: Blurred or pixelated text can sometimes be recovered. To hide passwords, documents or personal data, use Redact instead: it paints a solid block that cannot be undone.
blur_warning_body.description: Body of the one-time blur warning. This is a genuine safety point, not marketing - keep it plain and clear. Redact refers to the tool named in tool_redact and must match that translation.

blur_warning_switch.description: Button in the blur warning that swaps the active tool for the safe one. Must match the tool_redact translation.

blur_warning_keep.description: Button in the blur warning that dismisses it and keeps the blur tool. Must match the tool_blur translation.

blur_warning_dont_show.description: Checkbox in the blur warning dialog.

export_format_png.description: File format option. Best for screenshots containing text. Do not translate PNG.

export_format_jpg.description: File format option. Do not translate JPEG.

export_quality.description: Slider label, only shown when JPEG is selected. Do not translate JPEG.

toast_saved.description: Brief confirmation message after a download completes.

toast_settings_saved.description: Brief confirmation on the Options page.

options_title.description: Browser tab title and main heading of the Options page.

opt_language_auto.description: Language picker option: follow the browser interface language.

opt_after_capture.description: Options: what should happen once a screenshot is taken.

opt_delay_seconds.description: Options: how many seconds the delayed capture waits.

opt_seconds_value.description: Value shown next to the delay slider. Languages with plural rules should use a form that works for 3, 5 and 10.

opt_area_confirm.description: Options: whether releasing the mouse over a selection captures straight away or waits for a confirmation.

opt_area_confirm_ask.description: Area selection option: a small toolbar appears next to the selection with capture, save and cancel.

opt_area_confirm_instant.description: Area selection option: releasing the mouse captures immediately, with no confirmation step.

opt_ask_location.message: Ask where to save each file
opt_ask_location.description: Options checkbox. When off, files go straight to the downloads folder.

opt_filename_pattern.description: Options: template used to name saved files.

opt_filename_pattern_hint.description: Hint under the file name field. The tags inside braces are code - copy them EXACTLY as written and never translate them.

opt_hide_fixed.message: Hide floating headers during full page capture
opt_hide_fixed.description: Options checkbox. Prevents sticky navigation bars from repeating on every stitched screen.

opt_scroll_delay.description: Options: pause after each scroll step so lazy-loaded images have time to appear.

opt_default_color.description: Options: starting color for the drawing tools.

opt_default_stroke.description: Options: starting line thickness for the drawing tools.

opt_manage_shortcuts.description: Options link that opens the browser own shortcut settings page.

opt_reset_confirm.message: Reset every setting to its default value?
opt_reset_confirm.description: Confirmation question shown before resetting settings.

privacy_headline.description: Headline of the Privacy section. This is the core promise of the product - translate it with confidence and warmth, not legalese.

privacy_no_network.message: Your screenshots are never uploaded. This extension makes no network requests at all.
privacy_no_network.description: Privacy bullet point. This is a literal technical fact and must not be softened.

privacy_no_account.message: No account, no sign-in, no tracking, no ads.

privacy_local_storage.message: Settings are stored only in this browser, on this computer.

privacy_policy_link.description: Link to the hosted privacy policy page.

about_donate.description: Discreet donation link. Keep the tone inviting and never pushy.

about_translate.description: Link inviting users to contribute a translation.

about_rate.description: Link to the store listing review page.

err_restricted_page.description: Error title shown on browser-internal pages.

err_restricted_page_detail.message: Browsers block extensions on internal pages, add-on store pages and the PDF viewer. Try again on a regular website.
err_restricted_page_detail.description: Error body explaining a browser restriction, not a bug in the extension. The tone should be reassuring.

err_capture_failed.message: The capture failed. Please try again.

err_no_active_tab.description: Error shown when there is no page to capture.

err_page_too_large.message: This page is too long to capture as a single image. Try capturing a selected area instead.
err_page_too_large.description: Error shown when a full page capture exceeds the maximum canvas size.

err_clipboard.message: Could not copy to the clipboard. Your image is safe: try saving it instead.
err_clipboard.description: Error shown when writing to the clipboard fails. Reassure the user that the capture was not lost.

err_save_failed.description: Error shown when the download fails.

err_tab_changed.message: You switched tabs during the countdown, so nothing was captured. Start the capture again on the tab you want.
err_tab_changed.description: Shown when the active tab changes while a delayed capture is counting down. The capture is aborted rather than photographing the wrong page.
